clips.title: The story
paras: At Amberstill Ranch, the family tends the mountain rams and guards them from hungry predators. The homestead lies north of Gol'Bolar Quarry, along the snowy road to Loch Modan.

Amberstill Ranch raises mountain rams prized across Khaz Modan for their strength. The Amberstill family tends the stables and paddocks, training the sure-footed beasts for snowy passes and steep cliffs. The ranch supplies riding mounts and livestock, while the family fends off wendigos drawn to the flock.
